Before you call us.

Are the returns guaranteed?

No. Figures are management targets, not interest or assured payouts. Distributions depend on business performance, project progress and the LLP Agreement. Please take independent advice.

Can I exit later?

Exit is possible after 3 years for a fixed number of partners each year, at a fresh valuation. You can also transfer to another partner with management’s permission. Terms apply.

I live outside India. Can I partner?

Mention it on the call. Eligibility for partners abroad depends on current regulations, and the team will confirm what applies to you first.

Can I visit before deciding?

We’d encourage it. Mention it on the call and the team will help plan your trip to Kanthalloor.
